labels.name: recipe name
labels.world.configHash: hash of the world config (checked on load)
labels.bodies.pool: genomes file the bodies come from
labels.bodies.keep: bodies kept, by their place in the pool
labels.bodies.brains: the pool's own brains kept (absent: a fresh brain each)
labels.setup.floorClosed: tanks never refilled from the population floor
labels.setup.snow.islands.cover: share of the bed the islands cover
labels.leaves.spentUnitsPerCubicMetre: spent matter in the water at the start (units/m3)
labels.leaves.patches.ring: radius of the ring the patches lie on (m)
labels.search.evolveEnvelope: the joints' drive genes evolve as well
labels.search.crossover.rate: share of children made by crossover
labels.search.crossover.baseShare: share of crossovers based on the better parent
labels.search.crossover.mutationByDistance: mutation scaled by how far apart the parents are
labels.search.stop: stop before the cap when the search stalls
labels.search.stop.gain: least gain that keeps the search going (share)
labels.search.stop.over: generations the gain is measured over
labels.search.stop.floor: earliest generation the search may stop after
labels.exam.salt: number mixed into the exam's seeds
labels.exam.pool: genomes examined: every generation's top and the last elites
